purpose: Move to the next event or add another item.
keywords: Sentence / item + それから + next sentence / item.
I wash my hands. Then I cook.
Please buy milk, and eggs too.
We met at the station. Then we walked together.
formation: Sentence / item + それから + next sentence / item.
restrictions: Sequence and addition are related uses; context supplies the relationship.
mistake: For a clear causal conclusion, use a causal connector instead.
